payload.core_mechanism_summary: Exhaustively scan every cell in the 3D grid; a cell is critical if it has an incoming working neighbor and an outgoing working neighbor with no diagonal bypass.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a triple loop over all coordinates and a local rule, without any graph traversal, backtracking, or subset enumeration. None of the provided subtypes match; search_dfs_bfs_graph chosen as closest because the problem involves paths, but this implementation is a simple exhaustive check.
